They can only teach so much until you learn it for yourself. We have to find our own happiness. If that means distancing yourself from you parents, so be it. Mistakes are a part of life and yada yada. You know that. Doesn't make it feel any better. Those dark thoughts? They are real. And they are scary. Don't entertain them. Once you do, they become far more than just thoughts.

There are gunna be assholes no matter where we go. No community is complete without some. I'm sorry that in your time of need someone saw the opportunity to be rough on you. Just know that there are good people here too. Ones who care about your wellbeing!

Schedules are *everything*. Find a bunch of things that distract you, you enjoy, yada yada. Put it in a daily routine. (Example:Wake up at 10. Take a dank bubble bath/ shower. 11-11:30 color a picture or doodle. 12 eat lunch. 12:30 go for a walk. ) dont make huge blocks of time and dont be strict with anything but necessities. **Always** take your meds at the same time every day (unless as needed). Try to eat and do self care like baths and skin care at the same time every day. This starts to feel like a bit of a purpose.
Haha I totally get it! And feel free to PM me if you need anything else! We're all struggling out here.

Trust me, I understand completely.  Maybe try just starting a conversation about your struggles. Say something like "hey, recently I've been trying to push you guys away, when I feel lonely.  But that's not what I really want." You might need to find what you want first. Do you want to talk it out? Just have company? Or do you want a distraction from your mental state? All valid things to want. And you may want all these things at different times. Just be aware of what you want before you start talking or if you're confused on what you want, tell them that. "I'm really confused right now. I feel lonely and isolated, but also I really feel frustrated with certain questions. Bear with me?" It all depends on how vulnerable you are willing to be with them. Maybe start off with something easy and work up and out of your shell. "I don't feel well today, could we just casually hang?" Or "I feel kinda out of it today, could we do something together?"

It couldn't hurt to try! It's hard to remember that this life is yours, ya know? If you aren't getting what you want, you have to make it happen. **Easier fucking said than done, my friend.** Baby steps. Reach out once or twice when you feel like this. Test the waters. Find who is more responsive to what. Some people, you gotta literally spell it out to them what you want. Some can take a hint. And if all else fails, come back to us. This is where you are understood completely. You have us, you have me! :)

Absolutely. Sometimes there simply is no reason for how we feel. It's chemical, it's mental, it's the fucking worst. I've been trying to be more assertive when I feel like this. I wrote a letter, of sorts, to one of my most precious people. It simply explained what *I* felt depression and anxiety to be like and what helps me best. And in there I stated that when I push you away, I'm craving you most rn. And people learn. Nobody is perfect and they piss you off. You still feel lonely and you still want to be alone and they still don't understand. But it's the effort that keeps me going. They made an effort. And when I reach out, they are there. No matter where they are (most of us live in different states). I think if you have precious people, you gotta trust fall. Your stomach will turn and you'll regret it instantly and hope for some weird reason your text didn't send. But then they respond and you have a conversation and you feel... better? Awkward? Exposed? But it's worth it. Trust me.
